--- title: "Indian Head Park Municipality Projects" params: municipality: "Indian Head Park" format: html: toc: true toc-location: left code-fold: true df-print: paged execute: echo: false warning: false message: false --- [Township directory](../townships.qmd) · [Municipality directory](../municipalities.qmd) · [Search PINs](../pins.qmd) ::: {.cell} ::: ## Explore Parcels & PINs in Indian Head Park Gray footprints contain only exempt/railroad PINs. Blue shades distinguish single-PIN and multi-PIN projects within this region; colors describe categories, not individual project identities. White means unknown status or no 2024 observation. Pink marks footprints containing more than one category. Zoom in and click a parcel footprint to emphasize every mapped footprint identified as being part of a project, or common development (based on taxpayer/owner information). Click the blank map background to reset. Hover over a footprint for PIN classes, project PIN counts, latest BOR appellant names and their appeal tax years, and recorded buyer names when available; click to keep the details open. These names apply to the PINs in that footprint. An appeal tax year is the assessment year, not necessarily the filing date. Where multiple projects share a footprint, all matching projects are highlighted. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Explore Projects in Indian Head Park with multiple PINs Click a footprint to highlight the footprints sharing its key PINs; click the blank map background to reset. Only projects with at least two PINs **within this region** are included. Counts include unmapped PINs; shared footprints can belong to more than one project. Gray indicates a footprint shared by multiple displayed projects. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Indian Head Park Property Overview These counts cover distinct fourteen-digit PINs in the historical commercial/industrial universe (2006–2024). Status and parcel geometry are from **2024**. Region membership uses the universe's latest available geographic assignment; this is not a historical boundary analysis. ::: {#tbl-region-overview .cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Measure | Count| |:-------------------------------------------|-----:| |Historical C&I PINs (2006-2024 universe) | 26| |Observed in 2024 | 22| |Exempt in 2024 (class 0) | 3| |Incentive PINs (2024 classes 600-899) | 0| |PINs in a TIF (2024 membership) | 0| |Unknown 2024 class | 0| |Not observed in 2024 | 4| |Assigned projects | 14| |Projects with multiple PINs in this region | 3| |PINs without a project assignment | 8| |Mapped ten-digit footprints (2024 geometry) | 19| |PINs without usable 2024 geometry | 2| ::: ::: Of the 22 PINs observed in 2024, **3 are class 0** (13.6%). ## What types of property are these PINs in 2024? This table counts individual PINs by their **2024 assessor property classification**, with the class description beside each code. It does not count projects: one project can contain PINs in several classes. Because the sample includes properties that were commercial or industrial in earlier years, residential, vacant, and exempt classes can also appear. The final missing-record category has no known 2024 classification. ::: {#tbl-class-summary .cell tbl-cap='PIN counts by 2024 property class'} ::: {.cell-output-display} |2024 class |Description | PINs| |:----------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----:| |0 |Exempt or Railroad property | 3| |- |No record in the 2024 extract | 4| |100 |Vacant land | 1| |517 |One-story commercial building | 4| |522 |One-story, non-fireproof public garage | 1| |523 |Gasoline station | 1| |580 |Industrial minor improvement | 2| |590 |Commercial minor improvement | 3| |592 |Two-or-three-story building containing part or all retail and/or commercial space | 1| |593 |Industrial building | 1| |597 |Special commercial structure | 1| |599 |Commercial condominium unit | 4| ::: ::: ## Projects in Indian Head Park Counts and values include only PINs within this region. A project may extend into another region, so regional project counts are not additive. Unassigned PINs are excluded from project totals. FMV means estimated fair market value. Incentive PINs are 2024 classes 600-899. FMV is summed only over known 2024 values; an entirely missing valuation remains missing. The project identifier uses Appellant, falling back to Key PIN. Last Year of Paid Taxbill lists each distinct latest year in which a PIN had a bill greater than $0 during 2006-2024; it does not confirm payment. PINs without a positive bill in that history are identified separately. TIF counts use 2024 PIN-to-TIF membership records regardless of payment or increment, rather than positive distributions. Missing 2024 records are not counted as known TIF members. ::: {#tbl-projects .cell .column-screen-inset tbl-cap='Projects, appellants, and 2024 values'} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Sources and coverage Historical universe: `commercial_industrial_pin_universe_2026_09_21.csv`, derived from `comm_ind_PINs_ever_2006to2024.csv`. Classification and FMV: 2024 observations in that underlying extract. Project assignments: `project_assignments_phase7_2026_09_22.csv` (phase-7 key PIN). Appellants and appeal years: latest tax-year records for each PIN in `borappeals_UPDATED.csv`, including all ties. Names come only from BOR records for that PIN, with no fallback to reviewed names. Buyer names come from the assignment file; purchase years are matched by PIN, sale document, and buyer in Assessor_Parcel_Sales_20250105.csv. Unmatched years are shown as unavailable. Last positive bills use the 2006-2024 history, and TIF membership uses tif_record_present in the 2024 extract. Class descriptions: `class_dict_expanded.csv`. Geometry: 2024 footprints from `ptaxsim-2024.0.0.db`. PIN totals come from the tabular universe, independently of map coverage. Footprints are drawn once even when multiple PINs share the same ten-digit identifier. Assignment-review counts identify flagged records; absence of a flag does not certify an assignment. Directory and PIN-search pages may still use older data vintages.
